newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-BONALY PICKED ONLY AS FRANCE RESERVE.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-BONALY PICKED ONLY AS FRANCE RESERVE.

text.p: Five-times champion Surya Bonaly is only a reserve for the French team hosting the European figure skating championships in Paris later this month.

Not even a surprise ninth successive French title in Amiens in December only seven months after an Achilles tendon operation was enough to convince French selectors that Bonaly was ready for international competition.
The two French places in the women's event at Bercy in Paris are Vanessa Gusmeroli and Laetitia Hubert, with Bonaly as a reserve.
But Bonaly retains the chance of a place in the world championships in Lausanne in March if the other two both fail to make the top three at the Bercy.
In that case, a special competition in February will determine France's competitors in Switzerland.
